description: This file implements the SharedBuffer class and its nested Semaphore class, providing synchronization primitives and shared memory management for inter-process communication within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: SharedBuffer
classes.description: A class managing shared memory buffers with synchronization mechanisms for inter-process communication.

classes.name: SharedBuffer::Semaphore
classes.description: A class encapsulating semaphore operations for synchronization, with platform-specific implementations for Windows and POSIX systems.

methods.name: SharedBuffer::Semaphore::Unlock
methods.description: Releases the semaphore, increasing its count.

methods.name: SharedBuffer::Semaphore::IsLocked
methods.description: Checks if the semaphore is currently locked.

methods.name: SharedBuffer::Semaphore::Lock
methods.description: Attempts to lock the semaphore with a specified wait time.

methods.description: Constructor initializing shared buffer with a name.
